supersedes: CONCRETE_COMPLETENESS_V1 (engine commit 090a470, 00_ENGINE_FREEZE.json); V1 and its blind run (blind/, 01_BLIND_RUN_FREEZE.json) stay frozen and are never overwritten

weaknesses.W1_UNBOUND_MARK_CONSUMED_BY_PROXIMITY: a mark the route saw and could not bind (AMBIGUOUS / TAG_UNBOUND) was consumed by any unmarked held member within 1 m (an unresolved band): now only a member carrying the same mark consumes it; otherwise LABEL_NOT_CONSUMED / LABEL_MEMBER_CONFLICT with the route state; such a mark still counts as placed for the schedule
weaknesses.W2_HATCHES_TREATED_AS_ANNOTATION: fills on a layer whose name says hatch were dropped as annotation, and a fill inside any solid member counted as that member's: now fills are read on any layer except text / dimension / frame / grid / rebar ones; only the plan's column fill (pattern or layer found inside columns) is a member's own fill; any other fill on measured members is HATCH_ON_MEASURED_MEMBER (legend swatch names it when drawn; else candidates); a fill bounded by another unexplained group is that group's fill; a fill over the whole plan is SITE_FILL (LOW)
weaknesses.W3_FOOTING_EXPLAINS_ITS_CONTENT: a footing footprint explained everything drawn inside it (pit walls, a fill): now only footing / column layers
weaknesses.W4_PIT_SHAPE_UNNAMED: walls round a pit-sized area on a substructure plan had no family prior: a ring (or a closed outline whose inner faces stop at columns) enclosing 1-9 m2 inside the building votes LIFT and WATER_TANK (+2 each) beside the layer / note votes

discovery: W1-W4 were found after the V1 blind run was frozen and reconciled (13 of 32 completeness cases missed): each miss was traced on the drawing itself (CB10 / B7 route states, the S-HAT.BAT fills on beam bands and panels, the lift-pit walls and fill inside footing FF); no external quantity, no element id, no coordinate and no layer name of ST7757 is in the engine
development_options: V1 cases only, and with the V2 cases (generate(..., m6v2=True))
generator_change: V2 cases come from a separate random stream after every V1 element: with m6v2=False a drawing's entities and truth are those of the V1 generator (checked on dev seeds 1-16)
evaluator_change: family_of_detected_best_match added (family of the finding whose box best overlaps the element; a plot-wide box hits every element); the original family score is kept
heldout_rule: held-out V2 seeds 201-240 were never generated before this freeze; they are run once on this frozen engine (development and held-out vocabulary) and reported as they come out; the V1 held-out seeds 101-140 are re-run as a regression check
post_discovery_rule: the ST7757 V2 run (post_discovery_v2/, 03_V2_RUN_FREEZE.json) is POST-DISCOVERY: it shows what V2 reports on the drawing whose misses motivated it and is never presented as blind validation; the reconciliation matcher M2 was written before that run was frozen and is applied to V1 and V2 alike
known_context: V2 was written knowing the V1 reconciliation (which elements were missed and why); the rules are generic (no project mark, coordinate, layer list or quantity) and validated on held-out synthetic villas
